phases.name: Base conditioning
phases.focus: Establish movement quality, establish daily activity baseline, and begin fat-loss stimulus with moderate volume.

phases.name: Hypertrophy & control
phases.focus: Increase lean mass while refining glycemic control through structured resistance and metabolic work.

phases.name: Performance & stability
phases.focus: Advance conditioning, build sustainable energy expenditure, and further optimize blood glucose management.

non_negotiables: Workout in gym with access to machines and free weights
Monitor blood glucose before and after workouts as indicated by clinician
Have fast-acting carbohydrate on hand during workouts
Adjust insulin/medication in consultation with clinician per glucose readings
Start sessions with 5–10 minutes light warm-up and end with 5–10 minutes cool-down
Progressive overload with gradual volume/intensity increases
Nutrition plan includes total daily energy deficit, carbohydrate distribution around workouts, and fiber targets
Carbohydrate intake aligned with diabetes management and metformin considerations
Protein intake 1.6–2.2 g/kg/day to preserve lean mass
Limit added sugars and refined carbohydrates; emphasize whole foods
Glycemic awareness: monitor symptoms; adjust timing of meals and meds as advised
Safety: stop exercise and seek help if symptoms of hypo/hyperglycemia occur

stage2.text:
PLAN "12-Week Fat Loss & Glycemic Control Program"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary: 
    name "Fat loss with improved glycemic control in type 2 diabetes"
PHASES
  PHASE "Base conditioning" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Resistance training 60m "Full-body conditioning A":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_bench_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          seated_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_curl 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          overhead_press 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3m
          shoulder_stretch 2m
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Cardio training 30m "Low-intensity base cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 3m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 30m rpe 4
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 2m
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Recovery 0m "Mobility & light activity":
        warmup:
          cat_cow 3m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Resistance training 60m "Full-body conditioning B":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          barbell_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          leg_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          quad_stretch 2m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Cardio training 30m "Steady-state cardio":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3m
        main straight_sets:
          cycle 30m rpe 4
        cooldown:
          walking_calf_stretch 2m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Resistance training 60m "Progressive overload A":
        warmup:
          stair_step 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cable_pulldown 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 2x15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          hammer_curl 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 2m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Cardio training 30m "Bike intervals":
        warmup:
          easy pedaling 3m
        main straight_sets:
          interval 6x1m hard, 2m easy
        cooldown:
          leg_circles 2m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Resistance training 60m "Progressive overload B":
        warmup:
          rowing_erg 5m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          overhead_press 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 2m
  PHASE "Hypertrophy & control" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Resistance training 60m "Hypertrophy - lower emphasis on load":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          leg_press 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 4x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Cardio training 30m "Glycemic control cardio":
        warmup:
          walk 3m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 30m rpe 4
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 2m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Resistance training 60m "Hypertrophy sustainability":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          sumo_deadlift 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          pec_deck 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          skull_crusher 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          spine_stretch 2m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Cardio training 35m "Fasted-ish steady-state optional":
        warmup:
          light jog 3m
        main straight_sets:
          cycle 35m rpe 4
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Resistance training 60m "Hypertrophy A2":
        warmup:
          dynamic_mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 4x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          back_extension 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          military_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          cable_fly 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          ab_wheel 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Cardio training 30m "Intervals":
        warmup:
          jog 3m
        main straight_sets:
          6x1m @ moderate pace with 1m easy
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 2m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Resistance training 60m "Hypertrophy - volume increase":
        warmup:
          jump rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          bench_press 4x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          barbell_row 4x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
  PHASE "Performance & stability" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Resistance training 60m "Functional strength":
        warmup:
          mobility sequence 5m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          push_press 3x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up_banded 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x12 per leg rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 2m
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Cardio training 35m "Cardio endurance":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 30m low intensity continuous
        cooldown:
          forward_fold 2m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Resistance training 60m "Stability & athleticism":
        warmup:
          dynamic_stretch 5m
        main straight_sets:
          kettlebell_swing 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          trx_row 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          incline_pushup 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          core circuit 3 rounds:
            planks 30s
            side_plank 30s each side
            mountain_climber 20s
        cooldown:
          cobra_pose 2m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Recovery 0m "Active recovery & mobility":
        warmup:
          foam_roll 5m
        main straight_sets:
          mobility flow 10m
        cooldown:
          deep_breathing 3m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Resistance training 60m "Performance peak":
        warmup:
          high_knees 3m
        main straight_sets:
          clean 3x3 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          push_press 3x5 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          skull_crusher 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Cardio training 40m "Endurance finisher":
        warmup:
          jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cycle 40m steady
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Resistance training 60m "Deload & assessment":
        warmup:
          mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          core circuit 2 rounds:
            leg_raise 12
            russian_twist 20
        cooldown:
          full_body_stretch 5m
END PHASES

DAYS_PER_WEEK 4
DAY_TYPES
  - Resistance
  - Cardio
  - Resistance
  - Recovery

NON_NEGOTIABLES
  - Ensure medical clearance before starting
  - Workout in gym with access to machines and free weights
  - Monitor blood glucose before and after workouts as indicated by clinician
  - Have fast-acting carbohydrate on hand during workouts
  - Adjust insulin/medication in consultation with clinician per glucose readings
  - Start sessions with 5–10 minutes light warm-up and end with 5–10 minutes cool-down
  - Progressive overload with gradual volume/intensity increases
  - Nutrition plan includes total daily energy deficit, carbohydrate distribution around workouts, and fiber targets
  - Carbohydrate intake aligned with diabetes management and metformin considerations
  - Protein intake 1.6–2.2 g/kg/day to preserve lean mass
  - Hydration ≥ 2.0–3.0 L/day unless contraindicated
  - Limit added sugars and refined carbohydrates; emphasize whole foods
  - Fiber target 25–38 g/day
  - Glycemic awareness: monitor symptoms; adjust timing of meals and meds as advised
  - Safety: stop exercise and seek help if symptoms of hypo/hyperglycemia occur

Nutrition notes (summary directives):
  - Daily energy deficit: target approximately 500 kcal below maintenance, individualized.
  - Protein: 1.6–2.2 g/kg/day; distribute evenly across meals (≈0.4–0.6 g/kg per main meal).
  - Carbohydrates: distribute around workouts; favor low-glycemic, high-fiber sources; limit added sugars.
  - Fiber: aim 25–38 g/day.
  - Hydration: 2.0–3.0 L/day.
  - Metformin considerations: coordinate timing of carbohydrates with clinician; avoid large sugar spikes; prefer low-glycemic index carbs post-exercise to aid recovery.
  - Monitor blood glucose as advised; adjust meal timing and medications per clinician guidance.
  - Diabetic safety: incorporate fast-acting carbs on hand during workouts; stop if hypo/hyperglycemia symptoms occur.
